persona.en-US: 45-year-old male, overall responsible for factory operations. Focuses on overall operational efficiency, production KPIs, and ROI. Prefers data-driven decision-making but skeptical of new technologies.

concerns.zh-CN: 新系统是否能够真正降低生产停机时间？
concerns.en-US: Will the new system actually reduce production downtime?

concerns.zh-CN: AI系统的误判成本有多高？
concerns.en-US: What is the cost of AI system misjudgments?

concerns.zh-CN: 需要多大规模的变革才能成功？
concerns.en-US: How much organizational change is needed for success?

blindSpots.zh-CN: 不了解工程师对AI的技术信任问题
blindSpots.en-US: Does not understand engineers' trust issues with AI technology

blindSpots.zh-CN: 低估了与现有系统的集成复杂度
blindSpots.en-US: Underestimates integration complexity with existing systems

blindSpots.zh-CN: 不知道当前人工处理流程的瓶颈
blindSpots.en-US: Does not know the bottlenecks in current manual handling process

persona.zh-CN: 35岁女性，负责多个工厂改进项目。精通项目管理，关注时间表、预算和资源分配。
persona.en-US: 35-year-old female, responsible for multiple factory improvement projects. Proficient in project management, focuses on timelines, budgets, and resource allocation.

concerns.zh-CN: 项目能否在六周内完成并证明价值？
concerns.en-US: Can the project be completed and demonstrate value within six weeks?

concerns.zh-CN: 是否需要额外的开发资源？
如果试点失败，如何向高层解释？
concerns.en-US: How to explain to senior management if the pilot fails?

blindSpots.zh-CN: 不了解技术实施的具体挑战
blindSpots.en-US: Does not understand technical implementation challenges

blindSpots.zh-CN: 不知道告警数据的质量问题
blindSpots.en-US: Does not know about alert data quality issues

blindSpots.zh-CN: 错误假设AI是唯一解决方案
blindSpots.en-US: Incorrectly assumes AI is the only solution

persona.en-US: 40-year-old male, responsible for factory IT system maintenance. Many years of industrial automation experience, deeply familiar with existing systems.

concerns.zh-CN: 新系统如何与现有SCADA系统集成？
concerns.en-US: How will the new system integrate with existing SCADA systems?

concerns.zh-CN: 数据采集频率和延迟要求是什么？
concerns.en-US: What are the data collection frequency and latency requirements?

concerns.zh-CN: 是否有现有的自动化规则可以复用？
concerns.en-US: Can existing automation rules be reused?

blindSpots.zh-CN: 过于关注技术细节而忽视业务价值
blindSpots.en-US: Over-focuses on technical details while ignoring business value

blindSpots.zh-CN: 不清楚不同部门对AI的接受程度
blindSpots.en-US: Does not understand different departments' acceptance of AI

blindSpots.zh-CN: 低估了用户培训和变更管理需求
blindSpots.en-US: Underestimates user training and change management needs

text.zh-CN: 工厂每天产生约12,000条设备告警，其中大约80%是低价值的误报或已知问题
text.en-US: The factory generates approximately 12,000 equipment alerts daily, with about 80% being low-value false positives or known issues

text.zh-CN: 工程师平均每天需要手动处理约2,400条需要关注的告警（剩余20%）
text.en-US: Engineers manually handle approximately 2,400 alerts requiring attention daily (the remaining 20%)

text.zh-CN: 当前告警处理流程缺乏优先级排序，所有告警被视为同等重要
text.en-US: The current alert handling process lacks prioritization; all alerts are treated as equally important

text.zh-CN: 工程师花费约40%的工作时间在低价值告警上，导致真正问题响应延迟
text.en-US: Engineers spend approximately 40% of their working time on low-value alerts, causing delays in responding to genuine issues

text.zh-CN: 2023年因告警响应延迟导致的生产停机损失约为200万美元
text.en-US: Production downtime losses due to alert response delays amounted to approximately $2 million in 2023

text.zh-CN: 工程师平均响应一个告警需要5-10分钟，期间无法处理其他任务
text.en-US: Engineers take an average of 5-10 minutes to respond to one alert, during which they cannot handle other tasks

text.zh-CN: 当前使用的规则系统是5年前开发的，无法适应新型设备和工艺变化
text.en-US: The current rule-based system was developed 5 years ago and cannot adapt to new equipment and process changes

text.zh-CN: 75%的误报是由于规则系统无法识别工艺参数的正常波动范围
text.en-US: 75% of false positives are due to the rule system's inability to recognize normal process parameter fluctuations

text.zh-CN: 当前的告警处理方式每年导致约15%的设备预防性维护被推迟或取消
text.en-US: The current alert handling approach causes approximately 15% of equipment preventive maintenance to be postponed or canceled annually

text.zh-CN: 由于告警疲劳，工程师在夜间班次中漏报率高达30%
text.en-US: Due to alert fatigue, engineers have a 30% missed alert rate during night shifts

text.zh-CN: 工厂网络是隔离的VPC环境，不允许外部云服务直接访问
text.en-US: The factory network is an isolated VPC environment that does not allow direct external cloud service access

text.zh-CN: 预算限制导致我们无法聘请外部AI专家进行定制化开发
text.en-US: Budget constraints prevent us from hiring external AI experts for custom development

text.zh-CN: 管理层希望将工程师管理的告警数量降低50%，即每天只需处理约1,200条
text.en-US: Management hopes to reduce the number of alerts engineers manage by 50%, meaning handling approximately 1,200 alerts per day

text.zh-CN: 关键目标是将生产停机时间减少30%，预计每年可节省300万美元
text.en-US: The key goal is to reduce production downtime by 30%, estimated to save $3 million annually

text.zh-CN: 一线工程师对AI系统持怀疑态度，认为AI无法理解复杂设备行为
text.en-US: Frontline engineers are skeptical of AI systems, believing AI cannot understand complex equipment behavior

text.zh-CN: 工程师担心AI系统会产生'黑箱'决策，无法解释为什么某些告警被标记为高优先级
text.en-US: Engineers fear AI systems will produce 'black box' decisions without explaining why certain alerts are marked high priority

text.zh-CN: 如果AI系统误报率过高，工程师可能会忽略所有告警，导致安全风险
text.en-US: If the AI system's false positive rate is too high, engineers may ignore all alerts, creating safety risks

text.zh-CN: 系统如果在夜间自动抑制告警，可能导致紧急问题无法及时处理
text.en-US: If the system automatically suppresses alerts at night, critical issues may not be addressed promptly
